name: web-white-sidebar-navigation-collapsed-expanded-and-profile-menu
title: White Sidebar Navigation with Profile Menu
whatItIs: Three white app panels with window dots on grey: a collapsed icon rail with a Files tooltip and submenu (Images, Audio, Videos), an expanded sidebar with logo, search, grouped links and an expanded Files section, and a profile menu with view profile, support, wish list, shortcuts and logout.
whatItMeans: Showing the collapsed, expanded and profile states side by side explains a whole navigation system on one board, and monochrome line icons keep it calm.
techniques: Collapsed and expanded states shown together
Tooltip and flyout submenu on the icon rail
Indented submenu with a tree line
Profile menu as a separate dropdown

vocabulary.definition: A narrow bar of icons that expands into a full sidebar.
A small label shown on hover.
A thin vertical line joining nested menu items.
